question: How much does externally measured forward displacement differ from a30cmforward command under one fixed robot/controller/surface/start-pose condition?
expectedRobotModel: DFRobot Maqueen Plus V3 AA version MBT0050-AA with micro:bit V2; verify actual equipment before use
plannedBaselineController: Manufacturer distance/PID/encoder assistance, exact library/firmware/program revision and command units unresolved. This is assisted baseline control, not student-implemented PID or A*/Greedy planning.
unresolvedBeforeAnyCommand: Actual robot availability, model, firmware and library version; no purchase/delivery inferred from the previous user report.
Exact distance-command API/unit/completion and stop semantics; freeze reviewed program source and confirm a single deliberate start produces one command before the recorded series.
Choose a low fixed speed command after hardware/unit checks; record native units and do not substitute virtual cells/model seconds for physical calibration.
Reference-marker location relative to wheel-axis midpoint, initial orientation/alignment, ruler resolution, projection/readout uncertainty and physical measurement boundary.
Surface, battery type/start state, independent measurement method, operator, session ID/date and video reference if used.
controls: Same unchanging program/controller parameters and30cmtarget for all10planned attempts. No correction-factor fitting or tuning during this baseline series.
Same flat floor area, wheels/body configuration, start point/heading and same reference marker. Reset by hand only after the robot stops; begin and finish each attempt at rest.

Fix the speed-command setting and log battery observations/interruptions. If configuration changes, close this session with all attempts preserved and start a newly identified series.

measurement.primaryQuantity: signed forward displacement of the same reference point, projected onto the initial-heading axis; centimeters
measurement.secondaryQuantity: signed lateral offset from the start axis, right positive; centimeters
measurement.referencePoint: Fixed chassis marker associated with the midpoint between the two drive-wheel axes; identify/photo its actual placement before trials. Read its same ground-projected point before and after rest; report any placement/projection uncertainty.
measurement.externalReference: Ruler/tape and start/target marks. Manufacturer encoder distance is controller feedback and must not serve as its own independent physical ground truth.
measurement.distanceMeaning: Forward displacement and lateral endpoint offset are not actual curved path length. A path-length claim requires separate trajectory tracking.
measurement.timing: Optional physical duration, with method/resolution recorded; video uses actual timestamps from first visible motion to the first frame of settled rest. Never copy analytic model seconds into this field.

attemptAccounting: Retain all10attempt slots and every attempted start, including errors, no-motion events, interruptions and missing measurements. NOT_RUN slots stay empty; COMPLETED means an uninterrupted observed attempt with usable measurement, not arrival within any success tolerance. Overshoot/undershoot are outcomes, not grounds to discard a row. Record ABORTED or MEASUREMENT_UNAVAILABLE with reason/evidence where appropriate; never turn missing values into zero.

plannedAnalysis.summary: Report attempted/completed/aborted/missing denominators. Summarize only measured, pre-specified eligible attempts with mean signed forward error, mean absolute forward error and sample standard deviation; standard deviation is undefined below2eligible observations. Summarize lateral drift separately. No current values or tolerance-based success rate.
plannedAnalysis.calibrationFollowUp: A correction candidate may be proposed only after baseline inspection; assess it on a new source-frozen series rather than claiming improvement from the fitting data.
